study type: Historical cohort study with prospectively collected data
outcome: admission to the intensive care unit after delivery
rate of neonatal intensive care unit admission
cohort: 364 singleton pregnant AIP patients desiring uterus preservation
finding: REBOA can reduce intraoperative hemorrhage in patients with AIP.
mod_finding: This study investigates the use of REBOA during cesarean section for patients with abnormally invasive placenta (AIP) and does not compare different modes of delivery.
